title: DSWD gives P10,000 each to families of 5 Sorsogon fire fatalities

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in Bicol provided P10,000 in cash assistance to each of the five families of people who died in a fire that gutted the Sorsogon City Public Market on Saturday night, Oct. 24. Marygizelle Mesa, DSWD-Bicol regional information officer, said the agency had also arranged funeral assistance for the bereaved families and provided psychological first aid to help them cope with the loss of their loved ones.
